Automotive-Grade Data & Pipelines: Devise comprehensive data collection, annotation, and augmentation strategies specifically for diverse driver populations and real-world driving scenarios. Core Concepts : Solid grasp of mathematical, statistical, and information theory concepts, including linear algebra, calculus, probability theory, stochastic processes, and concepts like entropy. This theoretical foundation is essential for advanced algorithm development, particularly in modeling complex human behavior and uncertainty.
